title: Connectors
lead: Connect your accounts: WH3RE finds the places you love in them. You see everything, and nothing goes into your memory without your OK.

email.name: Email forwarding
email.text: Spots booking confirmations and some post-visit signals (like “thanks for your visit”) in the emails you forward, by hand or with a Gmail filter that only targets booking platforms. Never personal emails.
email.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect email forwarding? Places already imported stay, unless you delete them.

later.sms: Depends on your phone’s permissions. A web app can’t freely read your texts. Handy for Ontopo, which often confirms by text.
later.whatsapp: WH3RE can’t read your chats. It only uses: messages you forward, links sent to the bot, answers received through a WH3RE link, or a conversation you start.
later.instagram: No access to your DMs or your collections. You choose to share a post, a Reel, a place’s profile or a link.
later.tiktok: Same idea: you choose to share a link or a video.
later.maps: Your saved places and the reviews you wrote, where Google allows it in your country. Plus the links you share. Nothing is published.

platforms.title: Booking platforms
platforms.text: These are destinations, not unlimited sources: availability depends on the country, the place and the integrations possible. WH3RE sends you there, it doesn’t book for you.

api.deleteFailed: I can’t delete this source right now.
api.connectFailed: I can’t connect this source right now.

short.gmail: Find your past bookings in one click.
short.maps: Your saved places and your reviews.
short.whatsapp: Places shared in your friend groups.
short.instagram: The restaurants and bars you save.
short.tiktok: Places from the videos you share.

gmail.name: Gmail
gmail.text: Only reads emails from booking platforms (Ontopo, Tabit, Booking…), never your personal emails. Every booking found is shown to you before it goes into your memory.

contacts.name: Google Contacts
contacts.text: Reads your contacts’ names to suggest who to add to your circle. Nobody is added or told without you.
